sources.title: Golden Dragon Museum
sources.excerpt: The Golden Dragon Museum is a museum in the city of Bendigo, Victoria, Australia, dedicated to the culture and history of Chinese Australians, particularly in the region. Built on the historical site of one of Bendigo's Chinatowns, the museum's precinct also includes Chinese Gardens and a temple to Kuan Yin. Through the museum accreditation program, it was the first accredited museum in Victoria.
